name: שִׁלְחִי
summary: The father of Azubah, the mother of Jehoshaphat king of Judah; he is named only in the notice of Jehoshaphat's accession (1Ki 22:42; 2Ch 20:31). The name is the noun שֶׁלַח “weapon” in the form it takes before a suffix (שִׁלְחוֹ “his weapon”, 2Ch 23:10) with the ending ‑î: “my weapon”, or, taking the ending as that of an adjective, “armed, man of the weapon”. Scripture does not explain it.

evidence.note: “Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he began to reign … and his mother's name was Azubah, daughter of שִׁלְחִי.”
שִׁלְחוֹ, “his weapon”: the noun's stem before a suffix, as in the name.

note: Two uses. The ending ‑î is ambiguous between “my” and an adjective; the town שִׁלְחִים (Jos 15:32) has the same stem. A derivation from the verb (“one sent”) is possible and cannot be ruled out from two verses.
